tool_schemas.name: linear_create_issue
tool_schemas.description: Creates a new issue in the specified team and returns the created issue record (including its issue_id and URL). Validates required fields and formats (team_id ULID, non-empty title, optional assignee_id/state_id ULIDs, priority in 1–4), and rejects unknown fields. Raises NOT_FOUND if team_id, assignee_id, or state_id does not exist; FORBIDDEN if you are not allowed to create issues for the team or assign/set state; VALIDATION_ERROR for schema violations.

team_id.description: Team ULID the issue belongs to.

assignee_id.description: User ULID to assign the issue to.

state_id.description: Workflow state ULID for the issue.

estimate.description: Numeric estimate for the issue (e.g., points).

labels.description: List of label strings to apply to the issue.

tool_schemas.name: linear_update_issue
tool_schemas.description: Updates an existing issue by issue_id with any provided fields and returns the updated issue record (including its identifier and URL). Validates field formats and enums (non-empty title, priority 1–4, status in open/closed/canceled/deleted, ULID formats) and replaces labels when labels is provided. Raises NOT_FOUND if issue_id does not exist (or if provided assignee_id/state_id does not exist); FORBIDDEN if you lack permission to edit the issue or to change assignment/state/status; CONFLICT if the requested state/status transition is not allowed; VALIDATION_ERROR for schema violations.

assignee_id.description: Updated assignee user ULID (set to change assignment).

labels.description: Updated list of label strings (replaces existing labels).

tool_schemas.name: linear_search_issues
tool_schemas.description: Searches Linear issues using flexible criteria. Supports filtering by any combination of: title/description text, team, status, assignee, labels, priority (1=urgent, 2=high, 3=normal, 4=low), and estimate. Returns up to 10 issues by default (configurable via limit).

labels.description: Filter by labels; issue must match the provided label(s).

limit.description: Maximum number of issues to return (default 10).

tool_schemas.name: linear_get_user_issues
tool_schemas.description: Lists issues assigned to the specified user_id, or to the authenticated user when user_id is omitted, returning up to limit issues sorted by last updated. Results are not cursor-paginated; use limit (1–100) to control the maximum returned in a single response. Raises NOT_FOUND if user_id does not exist; FORBIDDEN if you are not allowed to view that user’s assigned issues; VALIDATION_ERROR if limit is out of range or user_id format is invalid.

user_id.description: User ULID to fetch assigned issues for; if omitted, uses authenticated user.

limit.description: Maximum number of issues to return.

tool_schemas.name: linear_add_comment
tool_schemas.description: Adds a markdown comment to the specified issue and returns the created comment record, including its URL and author attribution. Validates required fields (non-empty body_md, ULID formats) and accepts either an attributed author_user_id or custom author fields when provided. Raises NOT_FOUND if issue_id (or author_user_id when provided) does not exist; FORBIDDEN if you cannot comment on the issue or impersonate/attribute the specified author; VALIDATION_ERROR for schema violations.

issue_id.description: Issue ULID to add the comment to.

author_user_id.description: User ULID to attribute as the comment author.

custom_author_name.description: Custom author display name to show for the comment.

custom_author_avatar_url.description: Custom author avatar URL to show for the comment.

tool_schemas.name: linear_get_issue
tool_schemas.description: Fetches a single issue by issue_id and returns the full issue record (including identifier, URL, state_id, and status). Raises NOT_FOUND if the issue does not exist (or is status='deleted'); FORBIDDEN if you are not allowed to view the issue’s team.

tool_schemas.name: linear_update_comment
tool_schemas.description: Updates an existing comment by comment_id and returns the updated comment record. Only the comment body can be edited; deleted comments cannot be edited. Raises NOT_FOUND if comment_id does not exist; FORBIDDEN if you are not allowed to edit the comment; CONFLICT if the comment is status='deleted'.

tool_schemas.name: linear_delete_comment
tool_schemas.description: Deletes (tombstones) a comment by comment_id by transitioning its status from visible to deleted, and returns the deleted comment record. Raises NOT_FOUND if comment_id does not exist; FORBIDDEN if you are not allowed to delete the comment; CONFLICT if the comment is already deleted.

tool_schemas.name: linear_list_workflow_states
tool_schemas.description: Lists workflow states for a team, optionally including hidden states, and returns results ordered by position. Raises NOT_FOUND if team_id does not exist; FORBIDDEN if you are not allowed to view the team’s workflow.

team_id.description: Team ULID to list workflow states for.

status.description: Filter by workflow state visibility; use 'all' to include hidden states.

limit.description: Maximum number of states to return.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor from a previous response.

metadata.name: Linear MCP Server
metadata.description: This backend models a Linear-like issue tracker exposed through an MCP server, storing issues, users, teams/workflows, and comments. Core workflows include creating and updating issues, searching/filtering issues by common criteria (text, team, status, assignee, labels, priority, estimate), fetching
